description: Compare BackCalculation and Combined recovery after output saturation.

description: Compare raw and separately filtered PV using the same deterministic seed.

description: Combine saturation, slew, lag and deadband on one bounded actuator.

description: Validate one fixed PI across four declared FOPDT variations.

description: Stabilize a declared unstable state-space process and inspect constraints.

description: Keep a fixed controller while plant gain changes from 0.6 to 1.4.

description: Use each actual PLC interval under a deterministic jitter sequence.
